breakdown.description: Ideal-gas normal-shock relations are applied to liquid water without a valid equation of state/model.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly applies ideal-gas relations to 'water'. The ground truth corrects this by changing the fluid to 'air'. The agent's generated specification kept the fluid as 'water' while still using ideal-gas relations, thereby repeating the user's physically incorrect premise.
